# Blue Academy - Comprehensive Blue Mage Guide for FFXIV

## About This Site

Blue Academy is a comprehensive guide to Blue Mage, a limited job in Final Fantasy XIV Online (FFXIV). Blue Mage is unique among FFXIV jobs because it learns spells by defeating enemies that cast them, allowing players to customize their ability loadouts for different content types (tanking, healing, DPS).

This site provides authoritative guides on:
- How to unlock and level Blue Mage
- Spell learning mechanics and strategies
- Optimal builds and gear for different playstyles
- Masked Carnivale (Blue Mage's solo duty) strategies
- Savage raid mechanics for Blue Mage
- Theorycrafting resources and tools

**Author:** Liam Galt (https://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone/character/24242967/)
**Community:** https://discord.gg/mage-blue
**Updated for:** FFXIV Patch 7.5 (May 2026)
